args.body:
Hi Eve,

I just visited your blog at www.eve-blog.com and wanted to share some feedback!

I love that your blog has a clear personal touch and that you highlight your favorite hobby — hiking. It gives your site a warm, authentic feel. Here are a few thoughts:

1. **Content**: It would be great to see more detailed hiking posts — maybe trail reviews, tips for beginners, or photo galleries from your adventures. That kind of content could really engage your readers.

2. **Design**: A clean layout is always nice, but consider adding some visual elements like hiking photos or a banner image to make the site more visually appealing and on-theme.

3. **Navigation**: Adding categories or tags (e.g., "Trail Reviews," "Gear," "Tips") would make it easier for visitors to find content they're interested in.

4. **Engagement**: Consider adding a comment section or a way for readers to subscribe to your blog so they can stay updated on new posts.

Overall, great start — keep sharing your hiking adventures! 🥾🏔️

Best,
Emma Johnson

Hi Dora,

I just visited your personal website at www.dora-website.com and wanted to share some feedback!

1. **Content**: Your site has a nice, straightforward introduction. It would be wonderful to see more about your projects, interests, or professional background. Adding a portfolio or an "About Me" section with more detail could really help visitors get to know you better.

2. **Design**: A clean and simple layout is a good starting point. Consider adding some color, typography choices, or visual elements to make the site feel more uniquely "you."

4. **Updates**: Regularly updating your website with new content — like blog posts, project highlights, or news — can keep it fresh and give visitors a reason to come back.

Overall, nice work on getting your personal site up and running! Keep building on it. 🌟

Best,
Emma Johnson
